title: An intrinsic interval-deletion characterization of digraph support families
summary: For a finite directed graph with loops allowed, its supported subsets are those in which every vertex has an in-neighbour within the subset. We characterize exactly which set families arise this way on their original ground set. Starting from the power set, a legal step chooses an inclusion-maximal remaining nonmember, selects a previously unused root absent from every target-family member below it, and deletes the rooted interval.
